title: Memory access routine
statement: For each memory site, define a memory instruction at each phase of an access routine. The outward walk repeatedly tests register $r_T$: if it is zero, proceed to the memory operation; otherwise decrement $r_T$, increment $r_{T2}$, and move the memory head right before repeating. At the operation, set the current memory bit to $1$ at marking sites, and otherwise branch on that bit; then return by repeatedly testing and decrementing $r_{T2}$, moving left each time, and upon reaching zero continue to the site’s prescribed exit label for the resulting bit.
hypotheses_covered: A phase of the access routine
